key_findings.finding: The large IHC study PMID 16638854 (n=930) is relevant but does not directly report marker-expression frequencies across NPI categories. It shows NPI and ER were independent survival predictors in multivariable models, and Bcl-2 retained prognostic significance independent of NPI (validation HR 0.83, P=0.018; primary analysis HR 0.62, P=0.006), indicating that Bcl-2 adds prognostic information rather than demonstrating a conflicting NPI-group expression pattern.
